archetype: Luxury (Premium, Depth, Mystery) blended with High-Tech AI.

typography.pairing_strategy: The 'Old Money Tech' approach: High-end luxury Serif (Cormorant Garamond) for expressive headlines ('What would you like to build today?'), paired with a sleek, sterile geometric Sans (Outfit) for UI widgets, tech data, and body copy.

rules: No pure #000000. Base background is #0A0809 (Obsidian tinted with extreme deep burgundy/brown for a warm luxury feel).
Gradients are reserved strictly for primary CTA buttons, active state highlights, and magical AI text spans.
Hover states must shift to a lighter hue of the active state with increased contrast.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: The 'Crystal' Variant. Use backdrop-blur-xl with bg-white/5 (Dark Mode). Mandatory 1px delicate inner stroke (border-white/10). shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)].
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-white/5 for default containers. For the AI Prompt Textarea, use a glowing tracing beam effect or a subtle pink/gold gradient border to indicate 'magic'.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Deep ambient shadows. shadow-2xl for modals. Colored glow shadows (shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(216,27,96,0.2)]) around primary AI input.

buttons.primary: Pill-shaped (rounded-full), bg-gradient-to-r from-[#D81B60] via-[#FF4081] to-[#D4AF37], text-white font-medium, hover:opacity-90 hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(255,64,129,0.4)] transition-all.
buttons.secondary: Pill-shaped, bg-white/5 border border-white/10 text-white hover:bg-white/10 transition-all.
buttons.ghost: Transparent background, text-white/70 hover:text-white hover:bg-white/5 transition-all.

components.tabs: Segmented pill controls. Outer container rounded-full bg-white/5 p-1. Active tab rounded-full bg-white/10 text-white shadow-sm. Inactive text-white/50.

inputs.prompt_textarea: Massive padding (p-6), text-lg or xl, glassmorphic background (bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-2xl), 1px border-white/10. Focus ring: 2px solid #D4AF37 or pink-gold gradient. Rounded-2xl to 3xl.

components.modals: Auth & Buy Credits Modals. Heavy backdrop-blur-sm on overlay. Modal surface bg-[#141012] border border-white/10, rounded-3xl.

grids.feature_cards: Mode A 'Tetris' Grid for the feature comparison area. Wide gap-8. Mix col-span-8 and col-span-4 to create asymmetry.
grids.workspace: High Density Grid for the Builder workspace. 3-column layout where Sidebar is col-span-1, Live Preview is col-span-2 or 3.

layouts.page_structure: Navbar fixed top z-50. Hero section min-h-[80vh] flex flex-col justify-center items-center relative. Then structural sections for tools and deployment.
layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing. Use p-8, p-12, p-24 for section paddings. Container max-w-7xl mx-auto.
layouts.alignment: Hero centered for impact. Data/Tools left-aligned for functionality.

animations.ai_processing: Pulse and glowing tracing beams on pipeline stages (Planner -> Design -> Frontend -> Testing -> Deployment).

motion.rules: Micro-animations on every interaction. No 'transition-all'. Respect prefers-reduced-motion.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over gradients uses text-shadow or sufficiently dark colors if inverted. Body text vs #141012 must exceed 4.5:1 ratio.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid.

media.background_strategy: Use dark salon photography heavily darkened (bg-black/60 to 80 overlay) as a rich textural background for the Hero. Do not let details clash with the UI.

hero_background.description: Dark luxury salon interior. Use as hero background with a heavy radial black gradient overlay (bg-black/80) so only the edges show.

texture_overlay.description: Abstract dark gold texture. Use inside feature cards as a subtle background pattern with low opacity (10-20%).

3d_libraries.recommendation: Use framer-motion for UI transitions and react-fast-marquee for subtle 'Live Deployments' feed. TSParticles can be used in the hero background for elegant 'gold dust' floating particles to symbolize AI generation, keeping it extremely subtle.

instructions_to_main_agent.directive_1: You must implement the Mira AI Studio at /mira.ai as a polished, luxury SaaS platform. Incorporate the existing Miracurl brand identity (Gold/Pink-gradient, Serif Headings, Dark Mode) but elevate it for a high-tech AI builder.
instructions_to_main_agent.directive_2: Build out ALL key functionalities: Navbar with credits (e.g., '🪙 50 Credits'), Hero with 'What would you like to build today?' heading, pill-shaped build-type tabs, a massive glowing AI prompt textarea with example chips, and a split workspace (Sidebar menu + Live Preview Iframe + Pipeline Progress).
instructions_to_main_agent.directive_3: Create Auth Modal (Register/Login) and Razorpay Buy Credits Modal with detailed tiers. Add 'data-testid' to every interactive button and input.
instructions_to_main_agent.directive_4: Do NOT use pure #000000 or generic SaaS blue. Use the provided luxury dark palette.
instructions_to_main_agent.directive_5: Never use transparent headers over images without a glassmorphism backdrop filter.
instructions_to_main_agent.directive_6: Implement all icons using lucide-react unless instructed otherwise. Use sonner for toast notifications (e.g., 'Website built successfully!', 'Credits purchased!').

GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES: 1. Fusion over Imitation: Break category conventions by bringing salon luxury into a technical AI builder. 2. Emotion First: Make the user feel powerful and premium. 3. Content is King: Every step of the pipeline must tell the story of creation. 4. Zoom in: Use close-ups and heavy contrast. 5. Negative Space: Give the massive prompt area room to breathe. 6. Contrast: Soft pink/gold glows against hard dark matte backgrounds.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT:
You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
- Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
- Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
- Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
- Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur)
- You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms
- You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text
- Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style
- NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
- Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
- Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
- Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
- Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN
- Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable
- Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx
